items.label: 43" Propane Fire Pit Table – Warmth & Function in One
items.value: Enjoy adjustable flame control for cozy outdoor nights. The spacious 43-inch fire pit table doubles as a modern coffee table, creating the perfect centerpiece for gatherings, parties, or relaxing evenings.

items.label: Create a Cozy Outdoor Living Space
items.value: Transform your backyard, patio, or poolside into a stylish lounge area. Ideal for entertaining guests, family time, or quiet nights under the stars.

items.label: All-Weather PE Wicker & Heavy-Duty Steel Frame
items.value: Built with handwoven PE rattan and a reinforced steel frame, this outdoor furniture set resists sun, rain, and wear—designed for long-lasting durability in all seasons.

items.label: Deep Seating with Thick Cushions for Maximum Comfort
items.value: Ergonomic design with high-density foam cushions provides superior support. Removable, washable covers keep your patio set looking fresh and clean.

items.label: Flexible 4-Piece Sectional Layout
items.value: Easily rearrange the modular pieces to fit your space. Perfect for patios, decks, gardens, or poolside setups—adaptable for both small spaces and large gatherings.
